headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 data matching reaches 100%
summary: noire342 completed PAL v2.00 executable data matching in #242, taking the reported data figure from 99.95% to 100.00%. The remaining work separated the HUD clock format and let the linker produce the padding. PAL v2.00 code remains 100.00% matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: HUD selector field names (#243), shared Gadgetron pricing and ammo records (#244), and a shared controller-input structure (#245) were proposed but have not merged.
